defects.text: Disclosed coverage gap: shots._fixed_identity_snapshot (epl/shots.py lines 2513-2614, 35 statements) is not executed by the release-bar suite -- every manifest unit test monkeypatches it to stay hermetic and fast -- so its live git verification of the preregistration, Amendment 1, Amendment 2, the historical native generator bytes and the pinned data identities is proven by this freeze drill and by every live require_harness_manifest call rather than by the suite. Executing it in the suite would add roughly 19 seconds and a dependence on the host runtime lock, so it is disclosed instead of tested.

Disclosed scope record: the freeze parent gates in shots.make_harness_manifest and shots.harness_manifest_status, the receipt subject and the native contract were re-bound from the Amendment 1 commit to the Amendment 2 commit d4d2ce3d7b5fcb84545e83fed7cd4846129cad70 during this freeze phase. Amendment 2 section B2 disclosed this need and placed it outside the three riders, requiring the owner's freeze authorization naming Amendment 2; that authorization is the instruction under which H' was executed. Amendment 1 remains bound and independently verified, so the frozen bytes carry both governance shas.

Disclosed residual coverage: under the release-bar suite epl/shots.py is 81% line-covered (243 statements unexecuted) and epl/shots_harness.py is 67% line-covered (1,964 statements unexecuted). All fourteen durable-state taxonomy conversions are now executed -- the ten that Amendment 2 section B1 listed as unproven were each individually reverted in this audit and each turned its test red -- but the residual uncovered mass is not individually mutation-proven and is disclosed as such.
